title: HubSpot to lay off 660 employees
author: Beth Treffeisen
bullets: Business The Cambridge-based software company is cutting 7% of its workforce as it reorganizes to align with its AI strategy.

Chance Yeh / Getty Images for HubSpot Cambridge-based software company HubSpot is laying off nearly 660 employees, about 7% of its workforce, as it reorganizes around a new strategy focused on using artificial intelligence.
